status: Manual screenshot transcription for QA fixture design; not native-game event data.
limitations: The source is screenshots, not a WCL raw-event export or a Blizzard API packet.
Displayed two-decimal relative labels are rounded. Preserve screenshot row order among identical labels; never deduplicate by rounded time, source, spell and amount.
No GUIDs, spell IDs, exact timestamps, maximum HP, remaining shield amount, heal-absorb amount, cooldown readiness, charge counts, inventory, aura start/end, or native clock alignment are supplied.
Preserve displayed A:, O:, amount and asterisk fields. They are not independently verified exact HP losses/gains; do not add credits to damage or derive a health graph.
Source labels such as Axegrinder 8 and Axegrinder 10 distinguish instances in these screenshots only. They are not native source GUIDs.
Survival Last Usage is a displayed last-use fact, not proof of ready state, duration, or availability.
Reference target is Vandalxm, whose table includes Ice Barrier. Do not claim these are the user’s Arcane Mage events; an Arcane example must be a clearly marked synthetic fixture.
